description: issue #851: `set_shape "circle"` - `"circle"` is one of the four portable shape words that `spec/rendering.md` now requires every implementation to support (MUST, raised from SHOULD), so it is accepted, updates `turtle.shape` from the default `"turtle"`, and emits `shape-change` ({from: "turtle", to: "circle"}) with no diagnostic. Together with `set-shape-basic` (`"triangle"`, whose `from` pins the default `"turtle"`) and `set-shape-arrow`, the four portable words are now covered.
